request.prompt: Owner requests another DETAIL polish: consistent theme colors everywhere; left/right page swipes feel too abrupt. Produce a compact implementation-ready Apple Glass detail/motion specification board + actual HTML/CSS code. Existing screens/layout stay. Single interaction accent #0071E3 for nav, filter/period segments, toggles, links, input focus, auto-1R and neutral status icons. Green/red retained ONLY semantic trading direction, PnL and risk states; avoid stray jade interactive controls. Use existing glass white .62/.74/.88, SF system text #1D1D1F/#6E6E73. Show button/segment/slider and page swipe states. Horizontal navigation should follow finger before release, directional lock after deliberate horizontal move, ease-out 300ms finish / 220ms cancel, subtle small translation and opacity not full screen flash. No side-swipe navigation when drawing/dragging chart, slider, input, button, dialog or when vertical scrolling. Swipes should not create adjacent live data subscriptions, retain existing tab/component semantics, no new transaction/action. Bottom pill same color and geometry across all pages and no color flicker while changing tabs. Initial active1.618 centered. Honor prefers-reduced-motion. Keep all font contrast/touch targets >=44px and320px no horizontal overflow during gestures. Include first/last tab edge resistance and cancelled gesture state. Only visual/gesture polish; do not invent product settings, modify business copy, fees/TP/SL/order defaults, data or safety rules.

notes: Stitch design-only source; no generated data, trading functions or account claims imported.
